method.onsetEnvelope: 64-band mel log-power spectral flux (positive differences, mean over bands)
method.tempo: 8 s windowed autocorrelation of onset envelope (tempogram, 1 s hop) x log-normal prior (110 BPM, 1 octave); confidence = 0.4*local-tempo stability + 0.3*pulse clarity + 0.3*beat salience
method.beats: Ellis 2007 dynamic-programming tracker (tightness 100) over the full track; downbeats = beat phase with the strongest full+low-band onset accent for a 3 or 4 beat bar (estimate)
method.energy: RMS dBFS of the mono 22.05 kHz signal per 0.5 s block (index i covers i*0.5 .. i*0.5+0.5 s)
method.brightness: RMS-weighted spectral centroid per 0.5 s block
method.sections: Foote checkerboard novelty (6 s half-kernel) on a cosine self-similarity matrix of 0.5 s vectors [16 mel bands, RMS dB, log centroid]; times snapped to the strongest onset within 0.75 s
method.lift: lift(t) = dB(t..t+3) - dB(t-6..t) + 2*log2(centroid ratio of the same spans); the reported lift time is the steepest rise of the smoothed frame energy within -1.0..+0.5 s of the lift maximum, snapped to an onset peak within 0.15 s
method.windowScore: lift strength in 22-28 s + its dominance over other lifts in the window + start quality (sound present, onset at start, section boundary / estimated downbeat) + energy rise (22-35 s vs 0-12 s) + end drop (24-34 s vs last 2.5 s, section boundary or track end near the window end)
